messages:
Priya Raman: quick sync — from the postmortem we have 6 action items that are cross-team. need to confirm owners, blockers, and whether they require infra/planning that impacts the canary cutover. putting them here so we don't lose track :spiral_calendar:

Devon Li: sounds good. can you paste the list or link to the doc?

Priya Raman: yep — doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy... (postmortem -> action items). quick copy here:
```
1) patch KV cache expiry bug -> owner: TBD -> affects hosted API latency
2) add autoretry to model fallback -> owner: TBD -> deps: routing service change
3) dedicated pool QOS config -> owner: TBD -> infra change w/ firewall rules
4) alert tuning for regen loops -> owner: TBD -> monitoring team
5) canary rollback playbook -> owner: TBD -> runbook + runthrough needed
6) billing labels for dedicated capacity -> owner: TBD -> billing + infra
```

Sam Patel: I can take #4 (alert tuning) and do a short runbook. ETA by next Tue EOD? :white_check_mark:

Alice Kim: I can pick up #6 (billing labels) but will need a ticket to tie to infra changes. Sam — can you add me to the canary runbook doc when you create it?

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-042 (tracking cross-team postmortem actions)

Marco (SRE): for #3 (dedicated pool QOS) there is a blocker: firewall rule change requires sec review and a maintenance window. security sig-off isn't in place yet. if someone can own the security ask and schedule, we can get a tentative date.

Devon Li: I can own #1 (KV cache expiry). I'll open a PR and link tests. Target: this Friday EOD.

Priya Raman: awesome. updated list in the doc with owners. but we still need owners for #2 and #5.

Alice Kim: I'll take #5 (canary rollback playbook) but I need a dry-run with eng-sre and devex. propose Wed morning runbook drill — who from eng-sre can join? @Marco?

Marco (SRE): Wed 10am PT works for me. can we get PagerDuty rota confirmation? oncall-bot, please schedule a 30m drill at Wed 10am PT.

oncall-bot: Scheduled: Canary rollback drill — Wed 10:00am PT — 30 minutes — attendees: @Marco (SRE), @Alice Kim, @Priya Raman

Sam Patel: added a short alert playbook to the doc and created JIRA INC-2026-043 for alert tuning. assigned to me.

Devon Li: PR for #1 linked: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/824 — tests added. cc @Priya Raman

Priya Raman: great. two outstanding: #2 (fallback autoretry) needs owner from routing or runtime team; any volunteers? also we need to map any sequential dependencies (e.g., #2 must wait for #3 infra change?).

Alice Kim: I think #2 should be runtime-team first pass, routing adjusts after. tagging @Sam? (runtime lead)

Sam Patel: I can coordinate a runtime review but not own the full implementation. propose timeline: spike by Thu, handoff to runtime for full rollout next week.

Priya Raman: ok — assigning provisional owners in the doc: #2 -> Sam (coord) + runtime team (impl), #3 -> Marco (SRE) + security (sig-off), #5 -> Alice (playbook) + eng-sre drill Wed 10am.

Devon Li: can we add a little dependency map in the doc? I sketched one:
```
#2 (autoretry) -> depends on #3 (QOS firewall) for rollout window
#5 (rollback playbook) -> needs #1 (KV fix) test coverage + #4 alert tuning to validate triggers
#6 (billing labels) -> independent but needs infra ticket
```

Priya Raman: perfect. final asks: everyone reply here with confirmation and a short ETA. I'll update the Jira INC-2026-042 with owners and due dates.

Marco (SRE): confirmed for #3. I'll open the security ticket today and aim for sec sig-off by Fri. tentative maintenance window next Tue evening.

Sam Patel: confirmed for #4 and coordinating #2 spike. ETAs: #4 by Tue EOD, #2 spike by Thu.

Alice Kim: confirmed for #5 and #6. #5 runbook draft by Tue, drill Wed 10am, #6 billing labels PR by next Fri.

Devon Li: confirmed for #1. PR review requested. ETA: Fri EOD.

Priya Raman: thanks all. I'll post a short status update in the weekly incident digest and ping PMs for visibility. closing the loop here — please update the shared doc and the Jira tickets as you make progress :thumbsup:
